day_shape: 65 items: Trump declares Iran ceasefire over while claiming Tehran requested talks (denied by FM spokesman Bagheri), fresh US Treasury sanctions on Dubai-based financier Ali Ansari, UN Security Council told IAEA has 'lost continuity of knowledge' on Iran's nuclear programme, Qatari mediators in Tehran, and heavy regime mourning cycle for Khamenei.

threads.label: Trump ends ceasefire, Iran denies talks request
threads.summary: Trump declared the Iran ceasefire over on Truth Social while claiming Washington accepted an Iranian request to resume negotiations, warning of overwhelming retaliation if targeted. Foreign Ministry spokesman Bagheri said Iran made no such request and accused Washington of breaching the Islamabad Memorandum of Understanding.

threads.label: Qatari mediation and Muscat diplomacy
threads.summary: Qatari negotiators travelled to Tehran to create conditions for broader negotiations, according to a source cited by the Jerusalem Post. IRIB reported the Iranian Foreign Minister arrived in Muscat and was received by Omani officials.

threads.label: UN Security Council on Iran nuclear file
threads.summary: The Security Council held its 10192nd meeting on resolution 2231, hearing that the IAEA has 'lost continuity of knowledge' about Iran's nuclear programme following the JCPOA's collapse. UK Deputy Permanent Representative Kate Foster called for de-escalation and a return to diplomacy; a Jerusalem Post-cited CNN report said Iran is attempting to restore damaged nuclear sites.

threads.label: US sanctions and Hormuz demands
threads.summary: The State Department and Treasury announced sanctions on Dubai-based Iranian national Ali Ansari and a shadow banking network described as financing the Iranian regime. Separately, US officials demanded Iran publicly commit to halting attacks on shipping and opening all Strait of Hormuz lanes toll-free; the UN shipping agency urged rejection of Iran's claim over the strait.

threads.label: Khamenei mourning cycle and revenge messaging
threads.summary: Khamenei's office and IRIB/Defa Press published extensive coverage of commemorative ceremonies for the 'martyred leader', including a ceremony at the shrine of Fatima Ma'soumeh and Hezbollah Iraq calling the funeral a 'referendum'. Iran International reported Friday prayers nationwide featured clerics demanding revenge, rejecting negotiations and defending control of Hormuz.

threads.label: IDF strikes in Lebanon and Gaza
threads.summary: The IDF said an airstrike killed a Hezbollah operative near a tunnel shaft at the Ali Taher ridge in southern Lebanon and demolished five Hamas tunnels spanning two kilometres in northern Gaza. Separate strikes killed 12 militants including Nukhba cell commander Yahya Saeed Mohammed Hamdan, who raided the Re'im base on October 7, 2023.

threads.label: Iran domestic economic strain
threads.summary: Iran International reported wages barely cover food costs for many Iranian households and that renewed power and water outages have hit multiple provinces during summer heat. A ReliefWeb ACAPS report assessed humanitarian impacts of the US–Israel–Iran conflict under a 'tactical deal' baseline scenario.

events.title_en: Details of healthcare system measures in the funeral procession of the Martyred Leader. Jafar Miyad Farr, the authorised representative of the Health Ministry at the headquarters for the farewell, funeral and burial ceremonies of the Martyred Leader, announced details of medical services provided. For the first time, blood banks were established in three provinces: Tehran, Qom and Mashhad. Eighteen mobile hospitals were set up in three provinces: Tehran, Qom and Mashhad to provide appropriate medical coverage for pilgrims. For the Martyred Leader's funeral ceremonies, 510 health teams and over a thousand health experts were present in three provinces. In total, over three thousand emergency personnel, 840 rapid response teams and over a thousand ambulances, motorcycles ambulances and bus ambulances were on full standby.

events.title_en: Bagheri: We had no request for negotiations with America. Ismail Bagheri, spokesman for the Foreign Ministry, said in a telephone conversation with the news network: we have had no request for talks with America. America's treaty-breaking is a habit. If previously in 2018 their excuse was that they had a problem with the previous governing body, apparently now they even have a dispute amongst themselves. The memorandum of understanding, only twenty-two days after its signing, has been constantly confronted with violations of various clauses by America.

events.title: A Hamas commander who raided the IDF's Re'im base during the October 7, 2023, onslaught, was killed in an airstrike in the southern Gaza Strip yesterday, the military announces. The IDF says the Thursday strike killed Yahya Saeed Mohammed Hamdan, the commander of a Nukhba Force cell. On October 7, Hamdan raided the Re'im base, which houses the headquarters of the Gaza Division, according to the military. Recently, Hamdan worked to advance attacks on troops, as well as restore Hamas's capabilities, and therefore he "posed an immediate threat."
